title.zh: U.S. appeals court upholds designation of Anthropic as supply chain risk
title.en: U.S. appeals court upholds designation of Anthropic as supply chain risk

current_state.zh: A U.S. appeals court upheld the Pentagon's designation of Anthropic as a supply chain risk, a decision that stands to limit the AI lab's defense contracting over its usage guardrails.
